content.short: SkyMass provides UI building blocks and workflows to build high-quality applications.
content.description: SkyMass brings the cloud services model to application UI development, enabling faster creation of high-quality apps with a rich set of UI building blocks and workflows. The project lets users view all of their NFTs and flag spam NFTs using an NFT API, helping developers manage digital assets and keep collections clean. By integrating scalable cloud-based components, SkyMass supports building responsive interfaces that interact with NFT data across multiple blockchains.
content.meta: SkyMass enables building high-quality applications with UI blocks and workflows. Discover SkyMass and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
